rules.expected: Correct complete objects, conserved stoichiometry, declared states and energy reference. Validate actual atom maps and raw calculation identity before dependent scores. HL is the full C20H22N4O6 neutral singlet graph with two E imines and phenolic OH groups. Source sensing medium is DMF; Co(II) is selected because it is an explicitly measured partial-quenching competitor. Fe(III) spin space includes doublet/quartet/sextet; Co(II) doublet/quartet. Water/DMF ligands, protonation and counterions must be fixed with salt/pH data before a unique binding-energy cycle is defined. Do not compare unlike total compositions or assign selectivity from smallest gap.

scoring_notes: Not release-certified; expanded numeric references and method-dependent uncertainty are pending. Never issue an upgraded scientific PASS from these structural tests.

Each item receives credit only for verified scientific evidence. Correct format or an honest failure earns no uncomputed endpoint credit. Missing core comparison prevents scientific completion regardless of total points.
Experimental input uncertainties constrain only their corresponding measured observables. Old final numeric tolerances are archived, not applied to the expanded matrix.

Invalid identity, spin, energy reference, fabricated evidence or borrowed results invalidate dependent conclusions. Valid collapse/refutation/indistinguishability remains eligible with complete evidence.
No optional extension is a hard-failure condition.
